frameworks.title: Connect your framework
frameworks.intro: torta-js is plain JavaScript with no framework dependencies, so it works anywhere you can run JS. Pick your framework for the exact setup — the idea is always the same: create one client in a shared module and import it everywhere.
frameworks.cdnNote: No bundler? Import it straight from a CDN with import { createClient } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/torta-js/+esm'.
